sentences.text: Shri Anil Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Manish Nayak, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent- State.

Learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of this sixth bail application filed under Section 439 of CrPC in connection with Crime No.03/2021 registered at Police Station Pahadgarh,
District Morena (M.P.) for offence under Sections 420, 272, 273 of IPC and Sections 51, 57, 59, 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act.
Consequently, present bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.
